card.name: Words before household items or hardware parts
card.fires_on: Small words like use, a, an, and just before a household or hardware object in a list or instruction. Seen after never use before teaspoons, and in lists of board parts such as a power jack.

modes.label: The warning against household spoons
modes.description: The word use in a warning not to measure doses with household teaspoons or tablespoons.
modes.example: to never<< use>> household teaspoons or tablespoons to measure acetamin

modes.label: Parts list of a board
modes.description: Articles and commas inside a list of hardware features such as USB connection, power jack, ICSP header.
modes.example: a micro USB connection, a power jack,<< an>> ICSP header, and a reset

card.writes: It seems to suppress computer hardware words like USB, keyboard and desktop, so it steers the next word away from them.
card.plain: It responds to little words just before a named object, like a spoon or a power jack, in a warning or parts list.
